spans.s: (I)--a मन्त्रकृत्--a मध्य माध्वर्यु। Br. II. ३२. १०५; वा. ५९. ९६.

(I) (च्)--a kingdom to which the Yadus migrated.
1: भा. IV. २८. २८;

; Br. III. ४९. 1.
Its capital कुण्डिन, visited by कृष्ण.
2: भा. X. ५३. 6-7; Vi. V. २६. 1
Its king went to स्यमन्तपञ्चक for the solar eclipse.
3: भा. X. ८२. १३.

(III)--(वैश) son of ज्यामघ and शैब्या: married the young Bhoja girl (स्नुषा-वा। प्।) got in war and [page३-226+ २८] already appointed as his wife before his birth by his parents. Father of three sons of whom रोमपाद (लोमपाद-म्। प्।) was the most famous; the others were Krathu and कौशिक. all of them warriors. भा. IX. २३. ३९; २४. 1; Br. III. ७०. ३६-8. M. ४४. ३६; वा. ९५. ३५; Vi. IV. १२. ३५-38.
(IV)--an ally of कार्तवीर्य, killed by परशु- राम. Br. III. ३९. 2.
(V)--the wife of, taken away by Satyavrata. वा. ८८. ७८, १५५.
--the people of Vidarbha: these took part in the festivities connected with the marriage of रुक्मिणी and कृष्ण. भा. X. ५४. ५८; ८४. ५५.

--the place where श्राद्ध is performed; generally south west; three holes to be made and three pieces of खादिर (अचचिअ चतेछु) measuring the length of a cubit (अरत्नि) to be placed; then is the शोधन or purifi- cation of अग्नि by milk and ghee. वा. ७४. 7-११.

--a particular locality between the Cakra (Candra-वा। प्।) and मैनाक hills towards the south. Here is Samvartaka fire swallowing waters as also Aurva and वडवामुख. Br. II. १८. ७९. वा. ४७. ७५-6. [page३-227+ ३८]
(I)--R. from the परियात्र hill in भारतवर्ष. Br. II. १६. २८; वा. ४५. ९८.
--a caste equal to the वैश्यस् in प्लक्षद्वीप. Vi.

. (whole) chh. 2 and 3; 4. ३३-6; 5. 1.
Being addressed, Maitreya said that Vidura was god Yama incarnate, and gave him a brief description of the creations and of the knowledge of one god, and that Hari was the goal. Listened to the story of उत्तान- पाद and his line, and the discourse on आत्मन्.
3: Ib. III. chh. 5 and 7 (whole); I. १

; II. १०. ४८-50; IV. ३१. ३०.
Left for हास्तिनपुर; having abandoned his relatives came back to [page३-228+ ३२] them. Welcomed by युधिष्ठिर and others. Invited for युधिष्ठिर's राजसूय in which he took an active part, and approved of the anointment of युधिष्ठिर. Went to Syaman- तपञ्चक for the solar eclipse, and left it after it was over.
4: Ib. १

; X. ७४. १०; ७५. 6; ८०. [5]; ८२. २४; ८४. ६९[1]; XII. १२. 8.
Seen by अक्रूर, met by कृतवर्मन्, राम and कृष्ण.
5: Ib. X. ४९. 1 and 6; ५२. [५६ (v) 4 and १२]; ५७. 2.
After the death of धृतराष्ट्र and his wife, Vidura went on a pilgrimage and cast off his body at प्रभासा. Had realised the Yoga power of
(I)--a son of Suratha, and father of सार्व- bhauma. भा. IX. २२. १०; वा. ९९. २३०; Vi. IV. २०. 3-4.

(III)--a brother of Dantavaktra: Heard of his brother's death and attacked कृष्ण who cut off his head.
1: भा. X. ७८. ११-12;

. ३४.
Stationed by जरासन्ध on the eastern gate of मथुरा: arrived at कुण्डिन.
2: Ib. X. ५०. ११[2]; ५३. १७.
(IV)--(विदूर-वा। प्।)--a son of Bhaja- मान, a skilled charioteer. Br. III. ७१. १३६; वा. ९६. १३५. [page३-229+ २८]
(V)--a son of the IV. ऋतु (वा। प्।) सावर्णि Manu. Br.
(VI)--a son of निर्वृति and father of दशार्ह. M. ४४. ४०.
(II)--a son of चीत्ररथ, and of वृष्णि tribe. Father of शूर. भा. IX. २४. १८ and २६; Vi. IV. १४. २३.
(I)--a son of भजमान and father of राजा- dhideva. M. ४४. ७७.
(III)--the king and ally of भीष्मक and जरासन्ध. Vi. V. २६. 7.
--(वैदूरपतिस्)--contemporaries of seven Andhras and seven कौशलस्. भा.

(I)--(च्) kingdom to which the Yadus migrated. Its king was stationed by जरासन्ध on the western gate during the siege of Gomanta. The capital went by the same name, and here lived a prostitute पिङ्गला (s.v.) by name.
1: भा.

. २२; वा. ४५. १२३.
An eastern country;
2: Br. II. १६. ५४; M. ११४. ४५.
Parigha and Hari viceroys over.
3: वा. ९५. २८.
(II)--a name of Janaka. He had realised the Yoga power of Hari. भा.
--the capital of King Janaka; बलराम spent sometime there teaching mace warfare to Duryodhana. Vi. IV. १३. १०२, १०६.

(I)--leads to happiness: Role of teacher and pupil. A means to attain final beatitude;

; VI. १६. २७.
of १८ groups--also १४ groups;

survive अन्तर्क्षय.

(I)--not to have marital alliances with विश्वा- mitras, Khili Khilis, etc. M. १९८. २१.

(II)--१४ including मिमाम्स, न्याय, पुराण, धर्मशास्त्र,--१८ in number,--also includes आयुर्वेद. Dhanurveda, गान्धर्व, and अर्थशास्त्र;
1: Vi.
--a son of Sudaridra (s.v.) a poor Brahman of पाञ्चलदेश. M. २१. 3.

; १२. 4; १४. 5; ३१. 2.
सुदर्शन, a chief of;

[page३-231+ २७] country of, watered by नलिनी;
6: Br. II. १८. ६०; M. १२१. ४८; वा. ४७. ४७.
the path of.

. १३. and २२.
The performer of सौभाग्यशयनम् is born as a विद्याधर.
8: M. ६०. ४८.
--the city of the विद्याधरस्; in the region between the ताम्रवर्ण lake and the Patanga hills; there dwells पुलोमा, king of the विद्याधरस्. M. ६६. १८; ७८. ११; वा. ३८. 8-१६.
--a title got by Citraketu when he mastered the विद्या imparted to him by नारद. भा. VI. १६. २७-8.
--the over-lordship of the विद्या- dharas to be attained by काम.
--the women of the विद्याधरस्. भा. III. २३. ३७-8; Br. III. ५०. ४०.
--employed by सुनीथा in protecting the corpse of her son. भा. IV. १४. ३५.
--the राक्षस presiding over the month. Saha. भा. XII. ११. ४१.
(I)--a राक्षस of the fifth tala or महा- tala: a son of वाका having his city in अर्वाक्तलम्. वा. ५०. ३५; ७०. ५०; Br. II. २०. ३६;
(I)--a son of यातुधान: father of Rasana. Br.
(III)--a राक्षस, residing in the मार्गशीर्ष in the sun's chariot. Vi. II. १०. १३.
--a unit of time; also Vidyuti (वा। प्।) Br. II. २१. १२६; वा. ५०. १८०.
--a राक्षस with the Hemanta sun. Br. II. २३. १९.
(I)--one of भण्ड's eight councillors. Br. IV. १२. १२.
--a son of लम्बा and Dharma. Father of Stanayitnus (clouds). भा.
--a Vasu: a son of कृत, the learned friend of Indra, and a warrior. वा. ९९. २२०.
--a Mt. of कुशद्वीप. Br. II. १९. ५४; Vi.
(II)--बृहन्गिरस् and a son of वरूत्रि. Br.
--(मन्युमान्): a son of हृच्छय and जाठराग्नि and father of Samvartaka. Br. II. १२. ३४; वा. २९. ३२.
--Mt. a kulaparvata in the south of भा- rata वर्ष. वा. ४८. 3.
